content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am planning to replace my current hour meter with a smart PLC that supports WiFi, in order to store plant running hours and enable internet connectivity. I also want the PLC to have a display so running hours can still be checked locally if WiFi is lost. Could you recommend a suitable PLC for this purpose? Thanks, [user_name]
No [product_name] base module has built-in WLAN. You would need to use a WLAN adapter to add wireless functionality.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for a PLC with built-in WiFi to record and store running hour data, provide internet connectivity, and offer a display for local access during connection outages. Replies clarify that current [product_name] base modules do not have native WiFi capability, requiring separate hardware for wireless connectivity. There is a gap between desired features and what is currently available in the product line.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a PLC device equipped with built-in WiFi and an integrated display for both online and offline data access, allowing local data logging when WiFi is unavailable.
